answer: The trellis holds work receipts rather than names, so the beacon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. By the thread of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, capped per identity per epoch, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
